questions.q: He ___ keep leaving his dirty socks on the floor! It drives me mad.
questions.why: Наголошене *will* — упертість, що дратує. *shall* так не вживають; *would to* — зайве *to*; *is going keep* — бракує *to*.

questions.q: "She says she was ill." — "Well, she ___ say that, wouldn't she?"
questions.why: «Це на неї схоже» — *she would say that*. *will to* і *must to* — зайве *to*; *should* — порада чи обов'язок.

questions.q: You were driving far too fast. You ___ been killed!
questions.why: Могло статися, але не сталося — *might have been killed*. *may been* — бракує *have*; *must have* — висновок, що сталося; *should have* — «варто було».

questions.q: You're ___ to wear a seat belt in the back seat too.
questions.why: Правило — *be supposed to*. *suppose*, *supposing*, *supposedly* — неправильні форми цього звороту.

questions.q: He was supposed ___ me last night, but he forgot.
questions.why: План, що не здійснився — *was supposed to call*. *calling*, *call*, *called* — неправильні форми після *supposed*.

questions.q: I've heard this café is ___ to be the best in town.
questions.why: Репутація — *is meant to be*. *mean*, *meaning*, *means* — неправильні форми.

questions.q: It was so noisy that I could ___ hear myself think.
questions.why: «Ледве» — *could hardly hear*. *hard* — «важко, сильно»; *not hardly* і *hardly not* — подвійне заперечення.

questions.q: Last week I ___ work late every day because of the audit.
questions.why: Обов'язок у минулому — *had to*. *must* не має минулої форми; *must have* — висновок; *have to* — теперішній.

questions.q: The lights are off. They ___ gone to bed.
questions.why: Висновок про минуле — *must have gone*. *had to* — обов'язок; *must gone* — бракує *have*; *should gone* — неграматично.

questions.q: She ___ have taken the money — she was with me all evening.
questions.why: Неможливо, щоб — *can't have taken* (також *couldn't have*). *needn't have* — «було зайвим»; *shouldn't have* і *oughtn't (to) have* — докір.
Загальна властивість — *Accidents will happen*. *shall* — не про загальні правила; *would to* і *must to* — зайве *to*.

questions.q: You're not ___ to park in front of the gate.
questions.why: Заборона за правилом — *not supposed to park* (також *not meant to*). *suppose*, *supposedly*, *supposing* — неправильні форми.

questions.q: I can ___ wait to see you again!
You ___ (ought) to have told me earlier.
The film is ___ to be really good.
Yesterday we ___ (have) to wait two hours for the bus.

answer: He was supposed to call me yesterday
questions.why: План, що не здійснився — *was supposed to*.

answer: You might have been seriously hurt
questions.why: Могло статися, але не сталося — *might have been*.
